why: Declared before the run that is judged (docs/build/s1-result.md). Kept as the debugger's class table after D55 demoted the boundary diff from gate to debugger: the verdict is the FIRST boundary in execution order that leaves its class, not the count of differing rows, because a composed diff propagates and the count measures the propagation, not the faults.

classes.bit_exact: The device op is the host op's arithmetic in the host's order. Zero differing values is the bar; any differing value is a bug, not noise.
classes.ulp1_f32: A reduction whose association differs from the host's (D51). Bar: every differing value is within 1 f32 ULP of the host value, and no value changes sign.
classes.bf16_round: A boundary the host itself rounds to BF16 (the all-reduced attention delta and the routed-MoE delta). Bar: every differing value is within 1 BF16 code of the host value.
classes.composed: Not an independent op: the value inherits whatever the boundaries before it did. Judged only through first_differing(), never on its own.

boundaries.name: normed
boundaries.note: the entry's hc_pre collapse and its RMS norm: the reference sums sequentially in f32, the seam kernel sums per-thread then in a warp tree, so this is a D51 reassociated reduction and never bit-exact by construction

boundaries.name: lora
boundaries.note: the wq_a GEMV over the prologue's E4M3 codes; both arms launch b12x_mxfp8_gemv_m1_sm121 with the host's ascending-K order

boundaries.name: qnorm
boundaries.note: rmsnorm_sm121 owns one row per thread and walks columns ascending, which is the engine's linalg::rms_norm order one for one

boundaries.name: q
boundaries.note: the wq_b GEMV and the rope tail: same GEMV order, same rope tables, same rotation

boundaries.name: body
boundaries.note: the CSA2 sequence entry is the same cubin both arms launch; the window/store/index operands are the same rows

boundaries.name: attn
boundaries.note: the four per-rank wo_b partials are summed; the host's TCP reduce and the device's kernel sum them in different orders, and the released boundary narrows the delta to BF16, so 1 BF16 code is the class

boundaries.name: moe
boundaries.note: inherits attn through the hc_post residual mix

boundaries.name: pre
boundaries.note: the mHC coefficient sets are elementwise given the projection, but the projection's sum is the same reassociation as normed, so the set inherits it rather than being independent

positions.why: position 0 is the easiest case: no rope phase, one KV row, no ring wrap. The deep set crosses the 128-row window wrap and runs the compressed store and the indexer's selection over a full history, which is where a position-dependent bug lives.

role: DEBUGGER, not a gate (D55). Read by scripts/s1-first-diff.py to localise a divergence AFTER the amended numerical gate (D54/D55) fails, or when a slice claims bit identity. No row is filed against this file and it decides no PASS/FAIL.
